spans.t: Important: NaraaCare is a health-tracking app, not a medical app. Please check with your doctor
before changing your diet, fluid intake, sleep or exercise, and for any health concern. Rin is a wellness assistant, not a health advisor.
Effective date: 1 December 2026

spans.t: What we do not collect.

We do not collect your precise location, contacts, photos or files from your device. We do not use advertising IDs, analytics or advertising SDKs, or third-party trackers in the app. We do not buy data about you from other companies. We do not read health data from Google Health Connect or Apple HealthKit today; if we add this, we will ask for your permission first and update this policy.
Data about other people.
If you invite someone to a Care Circle by link, we process the invite only to let them join. Please share only your own information (see Section 7.4 of the Terms).

blocks.text: 4. How we use your data, and on what basis

spans.t: In short: we use your data to run NaraaCare for you, with your consent. We use some data without consent only where the law allows, such as to meet a legal duty.
With your consent.
When you sign up, we ask you to agree to these Terms and this policy and, separately, to the processing of your health data. We use your data for these purposes:
1. creating and securing your account, and signing you in;
2. calculating your daily water, calorie, nutrient and sleep goals from your onboarding details, and updating them when you edit them;
3. running your Hydration, Nutrition and Sleep avatars, streaks, notifications and reminders;
4. producing PDF reports and data exports when you ask for them;
5. running Care Circles, chat and connections, and showing your shared avatars to the members you choose;
6. providing Rin AI if you are on STAR and have given AI consent (Section 5);
7. managing your subscription and verifying purchases with Google Play or the App Store;
8. answering support requests and complaints;
9. improving the Service using aggregated, de-identified statistics that cannot reasonably identify you.
Without consent, where the law allows.

Under Section 7 of the DPDP Act, we may process personal data without fresh consent to comply with a law, court order or government request; to respond to a medical emergency involving a threat to someone's life or health; and for other legitimate uses the Act permits. This includes keeping security logs and records the law requires (Section 9).
Voice logging.

When you log food by voice (STAR), the speech recognition service built into your phone (Google on Android, Apple on iOS) converts your speech to text. Your phone's provider may process the audio under its own privacy policy. NaraaCare receives only the text, not the recording.
Barcode scanning.
The barcode is read on your phone. We receive only the barcode number, which we use to look up the product's nutrition information.
We do not

sell your personal data, share it for third-party advertising, use it to decide your eligibility for insurance, credit or employment, or make decisions about you that have legal effects using automated means.

In short: Rin is a wellness assistant, not a health advisor. It uses only the data you log in your avatars to give you personal answers, only with your separate consent. Your name, email and phone number are never sent to the AI provider.
What Rin uses.

If you are on STAR and give AI consent, Rin uses only your avatar data: the drinks, meals, sleep and workouts you log, the goals and progress shown in your Hydration, Nutrition and Sleep avatars, and the messages you send Rin.
What Rin does not use.

Rin does not use your name, email address or phone number, your onboarding details (including any medical condition), data that other Care Circle members have shared with you, or your Care Circle chats. Rin is not a doctor or health advisor; for any health question, please check with your doctor.
How it works.

For each message, our servers send the parts of this data that are needed for the reply, along with your message, to our AI provider (currently OpenAI). The provider generates the reply and sends it back. The provider processes this data outside India, and under its business terms does not use it to train its models. It may keep it for a limited period for abuse and safety monitoring, as described in Section 9. Rin's replies are generated automatically and are not reviewed by a person before you see them.
Your control.
You can withdraw AI consent at any time in Settings. Rin then stops working for you and stops using your data. You can delete individual Rin conversations, and Rin will then no longer use them.
Report insights.
For STAR reports with AI insights, the same process and safeguards apply to the report period's data.

blocks.text: 6. Care Circles: what other members see

spans.t: In short: you choose what to share and with whom.

When you join a Care Circle, members can see your username, profile avatar, the avatars you choose to share and their updates, and the messages you post. A shared Sleep avatar is visible only to members on STAR. Members do not see your email, your exact body measurements or your Rin chats. You can change what you share, leave a circle or block someone at any time. Members may already have seen updates you shared before you stopped sharing.

Legal and safety reasons.

We may disclose personal data where required by law, a court order or a lawful request from a government authority; to report offences as the law requires; to protect the rights, safety or property of users, the public or NaraaCare; or in a medical emergency.
Business changes.
If NaraaCare is involved in a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, your data may move to the new owner, which must keep protecting it under this policy. We will tell you before this happens.
De-identified data.

We may use aggregated statistics that cannot reasonably identify you (for example, the average number of glasses of water logged per day) to improve the Service. We do not sell or license this data to others.
In short: in India. A small number of providers process some data outside India.

8.1 Our servers and database are located in India. Data processed by the providers in Section 7.1 marked as outside India, mainly Rin AI data and sign-in, push and billing data handled by Google and Apple, may be transferred to other countries.

8.2 We transfer personal data outside India only as the DPDP Act and its rules permit, and not to any country the Government of India has restricted. We require providers to protect it with safeguards at least as strong as this policy.

blocks.text: 9. How long we keep your data

spans.t: In short: for as long as you have an account. When you delete it, your data is erased after a 30-day grace period, apart from limited records the law requires us to keep.

spans.t: Deleting your account.

You can delete your account in Settings → Account → Delete Account. Your account is deactivated straight away and permanently erased after 30 days, unless you sign in to restore it. Copies in backups are overwritten within a further 14 days.
Inactive accounts.
If you do not use NaraaCare for 24 months, we may close your account and erase your data. We will email you at least 30 days before we do.
What we may keep after deletion.
Only the records in the table above that the law requires, such as transaction records and logs. We keep them securely, use them only for that legal purpose, and erase them at the end of the period.
In short: we use strong safeguards, but no online service is perfectly secure.
10.1 Our safeguards include:
encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) between the app and our servers, with certificate checks in the app;
passwords, sign-in codes and session tokens stored only as secure hashes;
sign-in tokens stored in your phone's secure keystore;
a database that is not reachable from the public internet, with rules that let each account see only its own data;
staff access limited to those who need it, and logged;
limits on sign-in attempts and other abuse protections;
optional fingerprint or face lock in the app, and screenshot blocking on sensitive screens.

10.2 You can help by using a strong password you do not use elsewhere, keeping your phone's lock on, and telling us at support@naraacare.com if you think your account has been accessed without your permission.

blocks.text: 11. If there is a data breach

spans.t: If a personal data breach affects you, we will tell you without delay: what happened, the likely impact on you, what we are doing about it, what you can do to protect yourself, and who to contact. We will also report the breach to the Data Protection Board of India and send it a detailed report within 72 hours, as the DPDP Rules, 2025 require.
In short: it's your data. You can see it, fix it, take it with you, stop us using it, or delete it.
12.1 Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to:

spans.t: How we respond.

We will verify your identity (usually by asking you to write from your registered email) and respond within 30 days. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it, and does not affect processing that took place before you withdrew.
Your duties.
The DPDP Act also asks you to give accurate information, not impersonate anyone, and not file false or frivolous complaints.

NaraaCare is only for people aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If we learn that a user is under 18, we will close the account and erase its data. If you believe a child is using NaraaCare, please tell our Grievance Officer.

naraacare.com uses only cookies that are needed for it to work and stay secure, including security cookies set by Cloudflare. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies. If this changes, we will ask for your consent first.

We send service messages needed to run your account, such as sign-in codes, security alerts, subscription notices and updates to our Terms or this policy; these cannot be turned off while you have an account. Reminders, goal updates and Care Circle notifications can be turned off in Settings → Notifications & Reminders. We send product news or offers only if you agree, and every such email has an unsubscribe link.

We may update this policy when our Service or the law changes. For material changes, we will tell you in the app or by email at least 15 days before they take effect, and ask for fresh consent where the law requires. The effective date at the top shows the current version, and we keep earlier versions on request.
